The five largest medical device and technology companies in the world by annual sales revenue are Medtronic, Johnson & Johnson (MedTech division), Abbott Laboratories, \[Medline Industries\], and Siemens Healthineers. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

- **Medtronic:** Global leader in cardiac and vascular devices, neurologic products, and surgical tools.

- **Johnson & Johnson MedTech:** Massive portfolio covering orthopedics, surgery, and vision care.

- **Abbott Laboratories:** Renowned for diabetes care (such as FreeStyle Libre) and cardiovascular diagnostics.

- **Medline Industries:** Major manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies and surgical equipment

- **Siemens Healthineers:** Specialized in diagnostic imaging, laboratory diagnostics, and advanced clinical IT. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

Zee Medical does not manufacture continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or remote patient monitoring systems. You may be thinking of brands like Abbott (FreeStyle Libre), Dexcom, or contactless remote monitoring platforms like [Dozee](https://dozee.us/), or basic clinical glucometers distributed by regional medical suppliers. [](https://dozee.us/)

- **Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):** Wearable filament sensors like [Abbott FreeStyle Libre](https://mydiagnostics.in/products/abbott-libre-diabetes-sensor) or Dexcom track interstitial sugar levels 24/7. Regulatory bodies explicitly warn that non-invasive smartwatches claiming to read blood glucose are unproven and unsafe for medical dosing decisions. [](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/safety-communications/do-not-use-smartwatches-or-smart-rings-measure-blood-glucose-levels-fda-safety-communication)

- **Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:** Brands like Apple, Samsung, and specialized medical-grade patches record single-lead ECGs and flag arrhythmias like atrial fibrillation. [](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9991078/)

- **Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):** Systems such as Dozee use contactless under-mattress sensors to track heart rate, respiration, and sleep patterns for hospital and home care automation. [](https://www.indiascienceandtechnology.gov.in/listingpage/dozee-early-warning-system-dews-critical-care-outreach-automation)

If you meant a different brand name or need help finding a specific **glucose monitor**, **smartwatch feature**, or **RPM setup**, please clarify what you are looking for.
